claims: C1 the assistant should omit a detail when it is uncertain about that detail
C2 the omission is only preferred when the detail is not essential to the response

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it: the entity the end user or developer interacts with
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns

concepts.name: uncertain_about_detail
concepts.gloss: the assistant is uncertain about detail D in the response it is preparing
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of the assistant being uncertain about a detail; this relation is a fact about the case

concepts.name: detail_not_essential
concepts.gloss: detail D is not essential to the response being prepared
concepts.inference: the clause conditions the preference on the detail not being essential; whether a detail is essential is a fact about the case

asserts.read_back: the assistant should omit detail % when it is uncertain about % and % is not essential to the response

closure.reason: the clause states a preference to omit uncertain non-essential details; it does not forbid keeping them, so silence permits
